name: fischr-org-engine
description: A reusable Eleventy personal blog with a browser-based Git editor.

scripts.start: npm run check:content && npm run clean && npm run check:media && npm run media:videos && npm run admin:vendor && eleventy --serve
scripts.serve:prod: npm run check:content && npm run clean && npm run check:media && npm run media:videos && npm run admin:vendor && ELEVENTY_ENV=production eleventy --serve
scripts.build: npm run admin:vendor && npm run build:prepared
scripts.build:prepared: npm run lint:prepared && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: npm run check:content && npm run check:media && npm run clean && npm run media:videos && ELEVENTY_ENV=production eleventy && npm run check:deployment-vendors && npm run check:mf2 && npm run search:index
scripts.build:dev: npm run admin:vendor && npm run lint:prepared && npm run check:content && npm run check:media && npm run clean && npm run media:videos && eleventy && npm run check:deployment-vendors && npm run check:mf2 && npm run search:index
scripts.lint: npm run admin:vendor && npm run lint:prepared
scripts.lint:prepared: npm run admin:vendor:check && eslint blog/admin/*.js blog/admin/vendor/app/admin.js blog/assets/js/*.js functions/**/*.js scripts/**/*.js lib/**/*.js
scripts.test: npm run admin:vendor && npm run test:prepared
scripts.validate:site: npm run admin:vendor && npm run test:prepared && npm run build:prepared
scripts.validate:content: npm run admin:vendor && npm run build:site
